parsed.note_claim: The claim that a Ugandan court ordered a gay couple to give birth within 10 months or face life in jail is false.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: There is no evidence to validate the claim that President Museveni of Uganda said a jailed gay couple will be released only when one gets pregnant. Thus, the claim is FALSE.
parsed.reason: The 2021 page debunks a related but different viral claim (Museveni saying a jailed gay couple stays jailed until one gets pregnant), consistent with the note's falseness verdict but not addressing the 2026 post, the 10-month court order, or the Kenyan Facebook origin.
